description: This file provides a utility function 'inferColumns' for inferring column configurations for a DataTable component based on given data rows and an allowlist of fields. It handles renaming certain fields for display, filtering fields based on data presence, and special rendering for date fields.

methods.name: inferColumns(rows = [], allowlist = [], options = {})
methods.description: Constructs column definitions for a DataTable based on data rows and an allowlist, including handling date fields and label formatting.
